description: This file defines an interface DepositAccountDomainService for handling various deposit account operations such as withdrawals, deposits, and account closures within the Fineract project.

classes.name: DepositAccountDomainService
classes.description: An interface providing methods for handling deposit account transactions such as withdrawals, deposits, and closures.

methods.name: handleWithdrawal
methods.description: Handles withdrawal transactions from a SavingsAccount, considering transaction date, amount, payment details, and withdrawal fees.

methods.name: handleFDAccountClosure
methods.description: Handles closure of a fixed deposit account with payment details and user info.

methods.name: handleFDAccountMaturityClosure
methods.description: Handles maturity closure of a fixed deposit account, including transfer details.

methods.name: handleRDAccountClosure
methods.description: Handles closure of a recurring deposit account.

methods.name: handleFDAccountPreMatureClosure
methods.description: Handles premature closure of a fixed deposit account.

methods.name: handleRDAccountPreMatureClosure
methods.description: Handles premature closure of a recurring deposit account.

calls: SavingsAccountTransaction handleWithdrawal(SavingsAccount, DateTimeFormatter, LocalDate, BigDecimal, PaymentDetail, boolean, boolean)
SavingsAccountTransaction handleFDDeposit(FixedDepositAccount, DateTimeFormatter, LocalDate, BigDecimal, PaymentDetail)

SavingsAccountTransaction handleSavingDeposit(SavingsAccount, DateTimeFormatter, LocalDate, BigDecimal, PaymentDetail, boolean)

Long handleRDAccountPreMatureClosure(RecurringDepositAccount, PaymentDetail, AppUser, JsonCommand, Map<String, Object>)
